publication_policy: The skeleton is a draft layout and navigation instrument. Active content or visual placeholders block submission-ready and published stages and never constitute evidence, implementation, results, or claims.

placeholders.title: Inspectable record chain
placeholders.purpose: Define separately governed records and transformations from consented context through response.

placeholders.title: Semantic intent and conditioning state
placeholders.purpose: Define typed mixins, conflicts, exclusions, uncertainty, compilation, and human review.

placeholders.title: Two-rate architecture and authority
placeholders.purpose: Separate uncertain deliberation from deterministic rendering and identify authority boundaries.

placeholders.title: Receding-horizon planning and generate-ahead buffering
placeholders.purpose: Define planning horizons, deadlines, safety margins, fallbacks, and non-real-time claims.

placeholders.title: Semantic and waveform continuity
placeholders.purpose: Keep semantic interpolation and measured acoustic continuity independent.

placeholders.title: Exposure response and advisory updating
placeholders.purpose: Separate generated artifacts, exposure, response constructs, and approved later updates.

placeholders.title: Provenance and failure boundaries
placeholders.purpose: Specify provenance links, interruption, failure, recovery, and export boundaries.

placeholders.title: Research questions and feasibility stages
placeholders.purpose: Map research questions to design, technical, and within-person evidence stages.

placeholders.title: Units conditions and session structure
placeholders.purpose: Define units, conditions, trials, sessions, comparisons, and stopping points.

placeholders.title: Technical verification
placeholders.purpose: Specify authority, provenance, adherence, continuity, interruption, and recovery checks.

placeholders.title: Within-person feasibility measures
placeholders.purpose: Define separated subjective, behavioral, acoustic, and optional physiological measures.

placeholders.title: Assignment carryover and missingness
placeholders.purpose: Specify assignment, order, washout, carryover, burden, interruption, and missing-data rules.

placeholders.title: Analysis and sensitivity plan
placeholders.purpose: Freeze estimands, uncertainty, comparisons, visualizations, and sensitivity analyses.

placeholders.title: Protocol freeze safety and deviations
placeholders.purpose: Define version freeze, consent, retention, safety, review, and deviation handling.

placeholders.title: Technical verification reporting
placeholders.purpose: Reserve auditable technical evidence without presenting synthetic fixtures as outcomes.

placeholders.title: Control adherence and continuity
placeholders.purpose: Reserve requested-versus-realized control and continuity reporting.

placeholders.title: Exposure and response completeness
placeholders.purpose: Reserve provenance-linked exposure, completion, interruption, and response accounting.

placeholders.title: Subjective response and aftereffect
placeholders.purpose: Reserve separate perceived expression, felt response, usefulness or harm, and aftereffect reporting.

placeholders.title: Null negative missing and adverse observations
placeholders.purpose: Give non-positive, missing, interrupted, mismatched, and adverse observations first-class space.

placeholders.title: Contribution at the design evidence level
placeholders.purpose: Interpret only the framework and design contribution established by the manuscript.

placeholders.title: Moment-specific and negotiated personalization
placeholders.purpose: Discuss moment-specific human negotiation without assuming benefit or objective need.

placeholders.title: Alternative explanations and architectures
placeholders.purpose: Compare plausible non-adaptive explanations and alternative system arrangements.

placeholders.title: Bounded future research program
placeholders.purpose: Define falsifiable technical, within-person, and later multi-participant work.

placeholders.title: Construct and measurement validity
placeholders.purpose: Audit whether state, intent, response, usefulness, harm, and aftereffect measures represent their constructs.

placeholders.title: Internal and statistical validity
placeholders.purpose: Audit expectancy, demand, novelty, order, carryover, missingness, multiplicity, and researcher-role threats.

placeholders.title: External and ecological validity
placeholders.purpose: Bound generalization across people, moments, contexts, generators, devices, and listening settings.

placeholders.title: System model and continuity failures
placeholders.purpose: Audit model drift, poor adherence, latency, discontinuity, false inference, and fallback failures.

placeholders.title: Emotional safety and participant authority
placeholders.purpose: Address overwhelm, stop and grounding behavior, adverse response, and the person's interpretation.

placeholders.title: Consent privacy and data governance
placeholders.purpose: Describe consent scope, correction, retention, deletion, encryption status, export, and residual privacy risk.

placeholders.title: Licensing bias accessibility and hearing safety
placeholders.purpose: Address model and audio rights, dataset opacity, bias, access, sensory needs, and safe exposure.

placeholders.title: Independent review and collection gate
placeholders.purpose: State the actual review status and unresolved gate before formal collection.

placeholders.title: Public artifacts and reproducibility boundary
placeholders.purpose: Identify verified source, paper, software, schema, fixture, build, and provenance artifacts.

placeholders.title: Excluded and access-controlled material
placeholders.purpose: Identify private, sensitive, participant, copyrighted, weight, and generated-audio exclusions.

placeholders.title: Acknowledgements and funding verification
placeholders.purpose: Verify acknowledgements, funding, support, and omissions before release.

placeholders.title: Contributor roles and conflict verification
placeholders.purpose: Verify identity, affiliation, CRediT roles, conflicts, licenses, and approval.

placeholders.title: Whole-paper conclusion synthesis
placeholders.purpose: Answer only the design question supported by the complete manuscript and name later gates.

placeholders.title: Notation and symbol glossary
placeholders.purpose: Reserve one authoritative symbol table after the mathematical model stabilizes.

placeholders.title: Conceptual and operational equation classification
placeholders.purpose: Classify definitions, conceptual equations, operationalizations, estimates, and future empirical models.

placeholders.title: Frozen protocol and deviation record
placeholders.purpose: Reserve exact protocol identity, freeze date, amendments, deviations, and approvals.

placeholders.title: Claim and evidence classification index
placeholders.purpose: Reserve a reader-facing projection of governed claim classes and promotion decisions.

placeholders.title: Consent and context-projection record
placeholders.purpose: Reserve consent purposes, fields, exclusions, expiry, correction, and model-facing projection details.

placeholders.title: Provenance and reproducibility checklist
placeholders.purpose: Reserve protocol, source, model, artifact, exposure, response, exclusion, and claim audit fields.
